purpose: Add a fact that strengthens the same evaluation.
keywords: This bag is light. What is more, it stands up well to rain.
He was late. What is more, he did not contact us.
It is near the station, and the rent is low too.
restrictions: Often highlights an additional striking feature.
mistake: Use a contrasting connector when the second fact points the other way.

segments.role: Add a fact that strengthens the same evaluation. しかも + clause
